lines.en: : I know what I must do.
: This isn’t that kind of game!
: Who are you and what are you doing in my house?
: We’ve come to stop you from destroying everything you love and ultimately ushering in the start of Chapter 4.
: Put the gun down, Sensei. You don’t need to do this.
: Why should I trust you? I never gave you a key.
: Wouldn’t it be fair to assume that we just...got our hands on one the same way you just got your hands on like fifty of them?
: I don’t know what you’re talking about. But I’m going to give you ten seconds to get out of my house before I open fire.
: Okay, you can shoot now. I just wanted to make sure I had a front row seat.
: Hey! How come you remember Ami but not us? We’re just as important to the story as she is!
: Ayane and Maya. They’re your arch-nemeses and your current mission is to eliminate them by any means possible.
: We’re in for a long day, aren’t we?
: Wait a second. If you’re Ami, why are you covered in mosaics?
: I’m not! You’re just imagining that I am!
: I can’t trust any of you.
: Aaaaah! I’m getting out of here!
: Sensei! Stop shooting! You don’t understand what-
: Maya, wait! We’re supposed to stick together!
So it really is dangerous outside.
I shouldn’t have opened the door.
I manage to make it to the city streets with my life still intact, but I know that everyone is against me now. And I will stop at nothing to ensure my safety.
: Oh, Sensei. Have you calmed down yet?
: That was crazy, right? It really felt like you were trying to shoot me back there.
: Something still seems off about you...
: Again, you’re probably just imagining it. But that doesn’t matter right now. What does matter is giving you a quick mission briefing so we can get you to the roof on time!
: You escaped the safety room, so that’s where you’re headed next, right?
: I’m headed nowhere in particular. I just want to enjoy my freedom.
: Well, if you’re looking for suggestions on how to enjoy that freedom, why not pay the rest of the girls a visit?
: You’ve been gone for a really long time and we’ve all been waiting for you to come back, so I took the liberty of putting together a kind of...card! Of sorts.
: Yeah. I had everybody come up with a list of the things they like most about you because I thought hearing it would make you happy.
: The thing is, though, not everybody has processed your disappearance as well as I have. So most of them are broken now.
: Well, basically, they think they’re in the card. And that this city’s made of paper.
: You’re trying to trick me again, aren’t you?
: Of course not! I would never-
: Wait. Did I say “never?” I meant-
: Hm? My favorite thing about Sensei? Gosh...where do I even begin?
: At first, I thought he was just, like...normal. Just your average hot teacher without anything really remarkable about him.
: But as I got to know him a little better, I realized how nice he can really be when he stops acting all mysterious and quiet.
: My sister loves him too. And obviously, that’s a huge plus.
: Apart from Yumi, the two of us have been alone for years now. And I’d be lying if I said that wasn’t really hard at times.
: Having him around, even if it’s not as often as I’d like it to be, has been a total game changer.
: I think the thing I like the most is that I know he’d never do anything to purposely hurt me.
: Seriously? I really have to do this shit? But I barely even like the guy. Fuck do I care about some stupid ass card?
: We all know he’s probably just gonna jerk off on it or something.
: I don’t fuckin’ know. I guess if I, like...absolutely had to pick something...it would be that he hasn’t ever really given up on me. And that’s pretty fuckin’ rare when it comes to me.
: Shitty part is that “not giving up on me” leads to him basically being a fuckin’ stalker half the time.
: That shit’s creepy as fuck and it’d be really fuckin’ cool if he could give it a rest sometime soon.
: It’s kind of...hard to...put how I feel into words, but...I’ll...I’ll try my best...
: He’s not like...family or...anything like that, but...I think we...have a...kind of...special relationship?...
: I don’t...really look up to him, since...he’s...not a good person, but...I...
: When I’m with him...I feel kind of like...like that’s...where I belong...or something...
: Let me...Let me start over...I’ll...this time will...be better...
: Sensei is...kind of like...well, it...it feels like I’ve known him...a lot longer than...I actually have...
: I still...want to spend more time with him...
: Hahah! It would probably be easier to name all of the things he does that annoy me. But, for the sake of the card, I’m sure I can come up with something...
: Sensei...for better or worse, carries my life in his hands. And he’s yet to do anything to really let me down.
: Yes, he’s full of disappointments. But I understand that some of his tendencies are a direct result of things that he’s had to endure in the past.
: I hadn’t experienced true hardship until recently. And I understand how that can change a person now.
: So, if anything, I think he’s doing a great job as my mentor. Even if it seems like he’s trying to actively sabotage my future sometimes.
: At the end of the day, I don’t think I’d be able to live without him.
: I like his wiener! It’s all big and veiny and fun to squeeze. Oh, and that thing he does with his fingers where he starts goin’ all fast once you’re about to-
: Wait, you’re tellin’ me that ain’t allowed on the card? Crud.
: I can think of plenty of stuff, don’t worry! That was just the first thing that came to mind since it’s a pretty new development thingy for me.
: For actual stuff I like about Sensei, though...
: I think it’s cool that he accepts me for who I am. Or who I’m...currently being or somethin’?

: I don’t really know myself yet. I’m still tryin’ to figure out who the real Miku Maruyama is. And I like that Sensei doesn’t really pressure me into makin’ any big decisions before I’m ready for ‘em.
: Except for all those times he got a little too touchy before I was cool with that. But I’m super cool with it now, so-
: How long am I allowed to make this thingy? Like, is it cool if I do a whole essay or- really? A few sentences? Hmm...that makes it kinda tough.

: If you’re really gonna make me narrow it down, I’d probably start off by saying that I’ve never really had any close guy friends before. So he’s my first. And he’s so good at it that I don’t think I’ll ever need another.
: We’ve had our ups and downs for sure. But I feel like you kind of need to drive over a few bumps in the road if you’re ever really gonna bond with somebody, you know?
: It’s those hardships that strengthen the connection you have. And no matter what he does or what I do to mess things up, we always find our way back to each other.
: So...yeah. I don’t think I’ll ever have another friend like him. And I’m not just saying that because he’s twice my age and also pretty much my dad.
: A card?...Of course I’d be willing to write something. Sensei’s done so much for me since becoming my teacher and- oh! Sorry, I should probably be jotting this down, shouldn’t I?
: Let’s see...the easy answer would be to talk about what he’s done for my confidence. And how his constant reassurances always make me smile even if I can’t bring myself to fully believe them.
: But I think the thing I like the most is...hahah...it sounds kind of silly and embarrassing to say it out loud, but...
: I like the way he looks at me.

: I’m not sure if it’s just because of the bond we’ve built together or if it’s a little more complicated than that, but...sometimes, I don’t realize just how long our eyes stay locked on one another’s.
: Then, when I realize, I have to drag myself back to reality and tell myself that this isn’t just another one of my daydreams.
: This is a real person, who’s actively choosing to look into my eyes when it would be so easy to find another pair somewhere else.
She can be found in the dojo.
Would you like to go there now?
Are you sure? This action can not be-
: I will kill her and complete my mission.
If you are certain this is the path you wish to take, please confirm your decision in the following pop-up menu:
: What I like most about Sensei? Everything, obviously! And if you think that’s just a cop-out answer...I choose everything again!
: Even his worst qualities are amazing to me. And I can’t imagine a life, infinite or not, where I’m not by his side every step of the way.
: Hmm...what else...what else? Can I say “everything” a third time? Or is that starting to push it?
: You know what? Let’s throw a third everything in before I start getting slightly more specific and a lot more sentimental.

: I’m not related to Sensei. I don’t have that sort of special bond with him. And yeah, I’ve known him for a while, but there are some people who have known him even longer that I can’t really compete with.
: I haven’t chased him across Paper City for years on end or endured apocalypse after apocalypse in hopes that he’ll start to regain some of the memories we’ve made together.
: In fact, I haven’t really done anything other than just...follow him around.
: But I don’t think that matters.
: I don’t think you can really quantify love with some words on a card and...I think the idea of even verbalizing feelings as strong as the ones I have for him wouldn’t do them any justice.
: That’s why I’ll always choose everything.
: And there’s nothing you can do to stop me.
: I literally just told you that. There’s nothing you can do to stop me.
: I need to kill you to finish my mission!
: And what do you get for finishing your mission, Sensei? Is there some sort of reward?
: You mean you’ve been running around massacring the entire class for no reason whatsoever? That’s really mean.
: What’s happening is your future wife is coming to the rescue once again. So we can leave this place together.
: We’re not allowed to leave Paper City. This is the world outside the walls. I was safe. I was free inside of my box. I had everything I’d ever need.
: But you didn’t have me, did you?
: Maybe Maya and Ami are both wrong and I’m actually the main heroine? That’d sure be a twist, wouldn’t it?
: Come back to the safe house with me. There’s still a coconut crab. I can make hot pot for us.
: There is no safe house, Sensei.
: Let’s watch the seasons change together.
: I’m sorry, what are you asking me to do?
: My favorite thing about the Supreme Overlord? But why would- wait! Don’t tell me! This is for some big finale-style montage scene, isn’t it?
: Say no more! My favorite thing about Sir would have to be his...compassion? Guilt? Though, I’m not quite sure of how to describe what I mean without making it sound like an insult.
: Ah! Look at it this way — have you ever gone into a choice-based game and thought to yourself “I’m going to be a real arsehole this playthrough” only to pull the plug like, four choices later?

: I feel like that’s the boat Sir is in. I think, somewhere along the lines, he decided to play the bad guy. But now, he’s too deep into the playthrough to change his alignment and is just trudging through reluctantly.
: I don’t think he gets any real enjoyment out of making evil decisions. In fact, if anything, I admire his perseverance. Tons of people just turn off the game if it ever gets too hard.
: Sir’s the type to complete his mission no matter what. Even if it hurts him. And I think that’s a really cool quality for a person to have.
: Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please let me know if you have any questions about-
: Yes. I can provide feedback in regard to his character. But it will be honest feedback as I believe all reviews should be as truthful as possible.
: The Supreme Overlord has a complex flavor profile that only those with experienced tongues and distinguished palates can understand.
: He is unlike anyone else to ever come through these doors. And even if his taste is not specifically suited to my liking, I understand that all it may take to fix him is a little bit of salt.
: What I mean is that he’s almost there. Almost finished. Which makes watching him very exciting.
: Mmm...normally, I try to stay away from stuff like this. But if it’s for Sensei, I guess I can make an exception.
: It’s not like he hasn’t already heard all of this from me, though. So...not really sure what you’re trying to get out of just having it on a card, but here you go.
: The thing I like most about Sensei is how willing he is to put up with my endless barrage of problems and annoyances and that he’s yet to try and get rid of me for having them!

: And yes, I know it’s kind of selfish to have my favorite thing about him be more about me by proxy, but honesty hasn’t failed me yet and I’d really rather not stoop to petty lies to make myself look better.
: Oh, and if I’m allowed to choose a second thing about him, I like the way he squeezes my hand when he holds it. It’s kind of weirdly comforting in a way that’s hard to describe.
: I wish he’d do it more often.
: Hm? My favorite thing about Sensei?
: His wallet, obviously! Thanks to him, I never have to worry about paying extra for guac because it’s always comin’ outta his paycheck!
: In all seriousness though, I like his...how do I put this...unpredictability?

: I feel like he’s always right there when I need him or...want him to be. And it’s gotten to the point where I can’t help but laugh to myself about it because it just seems way too convenient most of the time.
: Actually, can you even really call it unpredictability if it keeps happening? Because there’s gotta be a certain point where the unexpected just...becomes the expected, right?
: And maybe that’s where I’m at with him. I don’t know- it probably sounds weird. But I like being able to count on him being there even when I never go out of my way to summon him.
: It’s...a relief, I guess. Having someone to fall back on who can distract me from the rest of the world before I even know I want to be distracted.
: Yeah, I can think of something for a card. When do you need it by?
: Wait, right now? Isn’t that kind of short notice?
: Then, uhh...I guess I...like that I can talk to him a little differently than I can talk to other adults. And I don’t mean that in a weird way this time.
: Sensei’s a weird dude. And he’s all sorts of fucked up. But I feel like he’s got a really interesting and distinct world view that makes it easy to open up to him when you don’t have anybody else.
: We’ve joked about it before, but I’m not really sure if he realizes just how much he feels like a brother to me. And, as an only child, I’ve always wanted someone like that.
: I just wish he’d stop making so many stupid fucking decisions.
: My favorite thing would have to be his mind of course. It’s so beautifully twisted that simply conversing with him is like climbing up the Enigma of Desire.
: Being near him makes me think. And I very much enjoy thinking. Especially when those thoughts don’t directly lead me toward some sort of conclusion.
: As you may have realized by now, I am very smart. And there are few questions I don’t know how to answer. But when it comes to all things pertaining to him, it feels as if all I can do is guess.
: It remains to be seen whether my guessing will lead to anything...but what I know for sure is I like watching him.
: I wonder if he likes watching me?
: Oh, what a splendid idea! I love things like this. I’m sure he’ll be delighted.
: To choose just one aspect of his person, though...hmm...
: What I enjoy most about our teacher is his...playfulness, I suppose. At least when it comes to how he associates with me.
: For as long as I’ve walked this earth, I’ve had what is essentially an army of servants waiting on my beck and call. Even now, I still have such an army. And this is not me bragging, I assure you.
: Sensei is the first person apart from my sister to treat me like a normal girl rather than royalty. And while that may have annoyed me before I was used to it...
: Now that I am, I can’t even fathom having that taken away from me.
: My favorite thing...is what he has seen. What he has felt. As everything you and I will ever experience is little more than an echo peeling off of his flesh.
: The amount of people who are truly gifted is dwindling by the day. And from the moment I met him, I could tell he was special.
: He has what it takes to fix this world. How very sad it is that he’s yet to embrace it.
: But that day will come. And when it does, you’ll be happy I led him to the light.
: For it will be that fateful meaning that spells out the rest of eternity and all that comes after.
: I feel like I’ve waited my whole life to answer this question, but now that I’m actually being asked it, I’m struggling to come up with anything.

: Ak- ahem. Sensei’s been a major part of my life since before I could even walk. So coming up with just one thing that trumps all of the others is like...picking out a favorite blade of grass in an open field.
: That’s probably not the best comparison I could have made, but you get what I’m saying, right?
: He’s just...he’s Sensei. I wouldn’t have spent years chasing after him if he wasn’t worth chasing after.
: Maybe that’s what I like the most? Just the fact that he’s been there forever and that I’m basically just a baby duck trying to keep up with him at this point.
: And...now that I say that, I’ve realized another thing I love about him.
: He doesn’t mind that I want to stay under his wing a little while longer...
: Even though I could probably fly whenever I want.
: Sure, I can tell you my favorite things about Sensei if you want. I just want to know how sexual I’m allowed to get first.
: Oh. Well, that makes things a lot harder. I’m sure I can figure something out, though. It just might be a little hard since our relationship has sort of...changed a lot since it started.
: You know, I really only started talking to him because I knew Ayane liked him and that he got along with Miku. But I’m really glad I did because he’s actually...
: Well, let’s just say I like him a lot. And not just because he’s easy to fantasize about when I’m alone in bed.
: I like him because he makes me feel better about myself.
: Maybe it’s because of the things he says to me. Maybe it’s because being around him make me feel good by comparison. Maybe it’s something else entirely. I have no idea.
: And he can totally knock me up if he ever wants to.
: Then it’s even worse than I thought...
: We’re going to need more cars. Call HQ and have them send out three more stat.
: And be careful not to touch anything. We don’t want it to spread.
I don’t think I’m supposed to be here right now.
I should leave before I get in trouble.
: Hey, you! Citizen! What do you think you’re doing? This is a crime scene. The general public isn’t allowed in here.
: I’m sorry. It won’t happen again.
: Exactly! By being here, you’re putting yourself in danger! And that makes us look bad!
: I guess I’ll be on my way then. I’m sorry, officers.
: You’ve got shampoo on you, don’t you?!
: Yeah, but...I thought I’d need it for something.
: Your mission is over, bucko! You should have known better than to bring contraband around the two toughest officers in Paper City!
I exit the dorms so the officers can finish their crime scene investigation.
I shouldn’t go back there again.
